finalText:
I went through all 380 commits and 128 PRs. Almost everything was dependency bumps, refactors, and test churn. Ten things actually change what users see, and I've written them into `CHANGELOG.md` under a new 4.2.0 entry.

One breaking change: an expired token now returns 401, not 403. One new feature: failed webhook deliveries retry on their own with backoff. Eight fixes worth knowing about, the biggest being that request bodies are no longer logged in full, and an empty allow list is now handled correctly instead of misbehaving.
